name: USB Milk Water Bottle Warmer Travel Stroller Insulated Bag Infant Bottle Feeding Warmer | Portable USB Bottle Warmer, Milk Water Warmer Safe Insulated Baby Bottle Stroller Bag Multipurpose On The Go O
description:
Product details of USB Milk & Water Bottle Warmer – Portable Insulated Stroller Bag ( Random Colour )

Product Type: USB Baby Bottle Warmer / Insulated Bag

Power Source: USB (compatible with power bank, laptop, charging adapter, etc.)

Material: Cloth with heating element

Size: 30 × 13.5 cm (inner diameter 55–75mm)

Temperature Range: 50°C – 60°C

Color Options: Camouflage White, Black, Blue, Pink

Origin: Mainland China

Package Includes: 1 × Bottle Warmer, 1 × USB Cable

Key Features:

Stretchable design – Fits most standard baby bottles securely

Keeps milk & water warm for long durations, ideal for travel & outdoor use

USB-powered – Easy connection to power banks, laptops, or adapters

Convenient for night feeding – Keeps milk ready while reducing stress for parents

Safe & insulated – Prevents hand burns when holding hot water cups

Compact & portable – Lightweight design, easy to carry in strollers or diaper bags

Perfect gift – Ideal for moms, daycare needs, and outdoor travel with babies
